subject: Timberly Labs — availability for POC kickoff and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Rivera <elliot.rivera@timberly.com>
Cc: procurement@timberly.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Timberly Labs — POC recap & suggested next steps

Hi Elliot —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks:

- Goal: validate Redwood inference for Timberly's document ingestion pipeline (latency SLOs and cost per 1k requests).
- Scope: 2-week POC covering 3 models (base gen + reranker + embeddings), S3 ingest, and basic telemetry.
- Success criteria: <2x current latency at 90th pctl for 2k qps, sample embedding quality that meets your relevance bar, and an ops checklist for production rollout.

Action items (proposed):
1) Kickoff call w/ SE + AE — schedule 30–45 min to align on test dataset and access.
2) Provide one sample dataset and an example query set (anonymized).
3) Procurement: rough timing for PO / initial onboarding budget (if available).

I've attached a short POC-setup checklist that outlines what we'll need on day 1. If that looks good, can you share 2 windows this week for a kickoff? Monica (cc'd) will lead the tech walkthrough.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148

Attachment: POC-setup-checklist.pdf

Just circling back on the POC checklist I sent yesterday. Any chance you had a window to share sample data or suggest a kickoff time? Happy to be flexible — if it helps, we can do a short sync with your engineering lead and procurement in the same call.

If now isn’t the right time, a quick note on timing would be great (this week / next / later).

Best,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Timberly Labs — align before next outreach

Team —

Elliot has been quiet since my two outbound notes (attached checklist). Before I send another consumer-friendly bump, I want to align quickly on the ask and what we offer in the re-engagement. A 15-min prep should be enough. Proposed approach: 

- Tone: low-friction, respect their bandwidth. Offer a narrow ask: 30-min POC kickoff with SE + sampling window and an optional short procurement readout.
- Value add: Monica to demo a 10-min warmed path (sample inference) so they see latency/cost tradeoffs. Sergio to bring a 1-page onboarding plan we can share as a follow-up. Laura — if we think it's stalled for budget reasons, should we offer a small one-off pilot credit to accelerate?

Questions for you (quick bullets):
1) Monica — do you have a short demo checklist we can include in the outreach?
2) Sergio — any red flags in the POC ask (data security / retention) that need to be preempted?
3) Laura — are you comfortable with a pilot credit if we add it as a CTA? If so, recommend amount?

If you're available, I propose 11:45 today for a 15-min prep (or reply with comments). If we agree, I'll send a concise re-engagement note to Elliot tomorrow midday.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Timberly Labs — align before next outreach

Rishi —

I can join a quick prep. Suggested additions to the outreach:
- 10-min sample demo (warm KV cache with a couple of typical queries) — shows token latency impact.
- Attach short checklist: "what we need from you for day 0" (credentials, S3 paths, sample size ~500 docs).
- If they care about quantization/instance types, call out that we can run an eval on their sample and recommend a config.

I'll attach a proposed-kickoff-agenda.docx after this email and can run the 10-min demo if we get a slot.

—Monica

monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Internal: Timberly Labs — align before next outreach

Quick notes from CS side:
- Data security: Timberly is sensitive about PII. Recommend we ask for anonymized samples or an agreement that they scrub PII for the POC. We should be explicit about retention — Redwood will not persist raw inputs beyond the POC unless they opt in.
- Onboarding plan: I can draft a 1-pager that maps roles and timelines; we can include it as a follow-up to the kickoff.

I'll be on the pre-call and can own the onboarding doc. No blockers from my side.

—Sergio

sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Suggest $2k credit to cover the first evaluation run — call it an "evaluation support credit". We should set clear boundaries (one-time, applies to Redwood hosted only, expires 30 days after kickoff).

If everyone agrees, Rishi, send the outreach tomorrow midday with Monica's agenda and Sergio's onboarding note attached. I'll approve the credit in the CRM once you log it.

Hi Elliot —

Hope you’re well — I wanted to follow up with a concise next step and a low-friction offer to help move things forward. We've agreed internally to keep this light and practical:

Proposal:
- 30-min POC kickoff (SE + AE + CS) to scope the sample dataset and day 0 tasks.
- Optional: a one-time $2k evaluation support credit to cover initial runs on Redwood hosted, expires 30 days after kickoff.

If that sounds reasonable, could you share two 30-min windows next week (Tue–Thu) that work for you and your engineering lead? If procurement needs to be on the call for timing, feel free to loop them in — I've cc'd procurement@timberly.com.

If now isn't the right time, a quick reply with timing (this week / next / later) is fine and we'll adjust.

Thanks for considering — we want to make this as easy as possible.

Best,
